title: Film Reel Dreamscape
description: A woman in a flowing blue cloak walks away down a stone path beside a canal, trailing long strips of film reels from her hand. The scene is set in an ornate open-air gallery with classical frescoes on the walls, glowing lanterns, and an aurora borealis illuminating the night sky above distant mountains.
